title: Structural Properties of DomiRank Centrality: Symmetry Axioms, an Entropy Bound, and Spectral Interpolation
summary: DomiRank is a node-importance algorithm for unweighted networks, defined by a dynamical model governed by a competition-strength parameter, a dominance threshold, and a decay rate. We establish three structural results. First, on symmetry. Automorphism-related vertices share the same DomiRank value, and a graph whose values are pairwise distinct must be asymmetric. The orbit count bounds the number of distinct values, and regular and vertex-transitive graphs admit closed forms. Second, on entropy.
